metaTitle: Custom Rectangular Hot Cold Packs | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom rectangular hot cold packs for effective pain relief. Perfect for corporate wellness kits. Contact Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Rectangular hot cold packs offer a practical shape for covering larger muscle areas like backs and shoulders, making them a smart choice for corporate wellness programs and safety kits. Unlike round or novelty shapes, rectangular packs provide even coverage for standard gel beads or nylon gel inserts, ensuring consistent temperature therapy. Decorate with your logo using full-color or one-color imprinting on the fabric cover for a professional look that employees and clients will appreciate.
heroAltText: Custom rectangular hot cold pack with corporate logo, blue fabric cover, ideal for muscle therapy and promotional giveaways.
